sections.title: 1. Educational and informational nature
paragraphs: The Site provides information, data, analytical tools, and content for educational and informational purposes only. Nothing published constitutes, or should be construed as, investment, financial, securities, tax, accounting, or legal advice, or as an offer, solicitation, or recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security, fund, financial instrument, or strategy.
Terms such as “buy”, “hold”, “strong buy”, “buy zone”, “risk”, or similar wording on the Site describe the output of a statistical model; they are not instructions or personalized recommendations.

paragraphs: BuyHoldTime and the people behind it are not investment advisers, broker-dealers, financial planners, or entities registered with or authorized by any financial authority (for example, the CNBV in Mexico or the SEC/FINRA in the United States). Using the Site does not create an advisory, agency, or fiduciary relationship between you and BuyHoldTime.

The information is general and does not take into account your objectives, financial situation, time horizon, risk tolerance, or needs. Before making any investment decision, consult a properly licensed financial, tax, or legal professional.

sections.title: 3. Signals, indicators, and scores
paragraphs: The BHT Index, the risk thermometer, Buy/Hold scores, bonuses (HY, liquidity, oil), valuations (P/E, CAPE, intrinsic value), and any other indicators are outputs of proprietary methodologies based on historical data and assumptions. They may contain errors, change without notice, be recalculated when sources are updated, or stop working under market conditions different from the past.
No indicator predicts market behavior with certainty. You should not base your decisions solely on the Site.

sections.title: 4. Hypothetical performance and backtesting
paragraphs: Simulation and backtest results are hypothetical. They are obtained by applying rules to historical data with the benefit of hindsight, do not represent actual trading, and may not account for—or may simplify—commissions, taxes, spreads, slippage, liquidity, dividends, corporate actions, or the emotional impact of trading real money.
Past performance, actual or simulated, does not guarantee or predict future results. Actual results may differ materially, including total loss of capital.

sections.title: 5. Investment risks
paragraphs: Investing in securities and funds involves risks, including partial or total loss of principal, volatility, and liquidity, currency, interest-rate, and credit risk. Leveraged or inverse ETFs (for example, TQQQ or SQQQ) amplify losses, rebalance daily, and can lose much of their value in a short time; they are not suitable for all investors.
Only invest money you can afford to lose and understand each instrument before trading it.
